record.field: # Force the frontend stylesheet and script bundles to be rebuilt. # hooks.py does this too, but Apps > Import Module strips Python, so without # this the browser keeps being served the previous stylesheet and none of the # theme's changes appear. att = env["ir.attachment"].sudo().search([("name", "like", "web.assets_frontend%")]) count = len(att) att.unlink() env.registry.clear_cache() action = { "type": "ir.actions.client", "tag": "display_notification", "params": {"title": "Liber theme assets", "type": "success", "sticky": False, "message": "%s cached asset file(s) cleared. Reload the website with Ctrl+Shift+R." % count}, }
